Agent‑OS Adapters
=================

This directory is reserved for Agent‑OS adapter code. In networked
environments, add the submodule:

    git submodule add https://github.com/buildermethods/agent-os.git third_party/agent-os

Only consume adapter interfaces; do not wholesale replace Code‑OS logic.

If submodules are unavailable, keep this as a placeholder and vendor
only specific adapter files as needed.
